entities.summary: Curzon, a notable figure in the history of Bangladesh, associated with British Raj and Bengali Nationalism (1905–1911). Preceded by Partition of Bengal 1905 and Swadeshi Movement. Their legacy influenced Muslim League and Partition of India creates East Pakistan from Muslim-majority Bengal.
